subject: English Learner Monitoring and ADA Planning
overview: The committee reviewed a state monitoring report on English learner programs and approved funding for skylight repairs at the McGlynn School. Members also initiated a formal review of ADA compliance at the high school and updated policies regarding meeting agendas.

items.title: Consent Agenda and Superintendent's Report
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda including minutes from the April 29, 2024 meeting. The Superintendent recognized Teacher and Nurse Appreciation Week, highlighted Mental Health Awareness Month, and announced upcoming kindergarten open houses and early release days.

items.title: English Learner Tiered Focus Monitoring Review
items.summary: Director Paul Teixeira reported that the district met state and federal requirements in 10 out of 12 focus areas; a corrective action plan is in place to address student progress on access tests and General Education teacher licensure endorsements. The district expects to resolve licensure requirements for approximately 18 teachers by January 2025.

items.title: Out-of-State Athletics Trip
items.summary: Approved a request for the girls varsity basketball team to participate in a sanctioned tournament in Florida from December 26 to December 31, 2024.

items.title: McGlynn School Skylight Repair
items.summary: Approved $29,480 in ARPA revenue replacement funding to repair leaking skylights at the McGlynn School, with work expected to be completed within three months.

items.title: ADA Compliance and Remediation Planning
items.summary: Approved a resolution for the Building and Grounds Subcommittee to review ADA noncompliance at Medford High School alongside the Universal Safety Committee and disability advocates. The subcommittee will explore grant funding for remediation and is required to report back on progress by October 1, 2024.

items.title: Policy BEDB Updates
items.summary: Approved two updates to policy BEDB to include recording notifications on regular meeting agendas and to permit the inclusion of capital purchase approvals within the consent agenda.

items.title: Condolences and Adjournment
items.summary: The committee observed a moment of silence for Robert D. Kane, a former teacher and director of the Medford Summer School Program.
